description: Use when the user wants a SteamID converted between formats - steamid64 (dec and hex), STEAM_1:0:x, legacy STEAM_0, [U:1:x], 32-bit account id, steam:hex (FiveM) or the profile URL - starting from any one of them, instantly and offline. CHEAPEST TOOL: prefer it over steam_identity whenever only format conversion is needed. Do not use for vanity names (steamcommunity.com/id/name is not a computable format - use steam_identity) or for profile data (steam_profile).

id.description: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id or a /profiles/ link. NOT a vanity name

name: steam_convert

input_format.description: which format the input was recognized as
